name: athenaeum-populi-hugo
description: Hugo build of Athenaeum Populi. Keep the dependency list deliberately small and document any new runtime dependency in the README and lockfile.

scripts.build: npm run build:hugo && npm run search:index
scripts.check:build: npm run check:routes && npm run check:links && npm run check:search && npm run audit:build
scripts.ci: npm test && npm run build && npm run check:build
scripts.test: node --test && npm run validate && npm run verify:content && npm run lint

//deps: esbuild is NOT listed: Hugo Pipes js.Build embeds esbuild. katex/mathlive/pagefind are pinned: KaTeX assets are vendored for offline builds, MathLive supplies math input, and Pagefind builds one global site-wide search index.
//versions: KaTeX 0.16.22 matches the engine embedded in Hugo 0.164.0; its CSS must match Hugo's generated HTML. MathLive 0.110.0 and @cortex-js/compute-engine 0.58.0 are pinned because grading behavior is version-sensitive. Upgrade these versions only as a coordinated, fully verified architecture change.
